purpose: One share of a SplitBar, as wide as its percentage of what is shown, carrying its label and value when they fit. It is pressable and reports the press to the bar.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a SplitBar.
A progress fill for a single value.
A tag or label coloured by category.

Series=1.visual: Fill Chart/series-1/soft, right edge Chart/series-1/solid, label and value in Chart/series-1/content.

Series=2.visual: Fill Chart/series-2/soft, right edge Chart/series-2/solid, label and value in Chart/series-2/content.

Default.visual: Its series fill at its share of the bar.

Focused.meaning: Reached by keyboard or hovered (there is no Hover colour).
Focused.visual: A focus ring inside the segment in Border/ring/neutral; the segment widens to fit its text.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space presses it (onSegmentClick).
a11y.reducedMotion: Decided by the motion foundation: the motion roles fall back to the system fade with no travel (design-plans/splitbar-contract.md).
notes: The visible text is aria-hidden; the aria-label carries label, share and value ("Organic search, 41.6%, 41,300 sessions").
The width changes with use-hover, and with use-travel-in / use-travel-out when series reflow (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Segments under 5 % can be narrower than 24 px. Should hover-widening or a minimum width guarantee the target size?
Contrast: Chart/series-n/content on Chart/series-n/soft is under 4.5:1 in Light for series 2, 3, 4 and 6 (COL-CHART-01). Fix the roles or accept?
The segment edge width is bound to Stroke/focus, the focus-ring width (candidate DIM-03). Does it need its own stroke role?
